set.body: Goal: promote PanelMargins/PanelLayout from a fixed panel contract into a plot layout solver that allocates panel, axis, legend, and future facet-strip regions. Acceptance: layout produces stable named viewports/frames; guide placement no longer relies on hard-coded legend coordinates in domain adapters; region sizes come from declared extents plus a conservative portable text-extent estimator behind an explicit capability (so JVM/JS backends can later refine with real font metrics without changing the solver contract); placement and default sizes come from an explicit layout policy value rather than hard-coded npc constants scattered across GuideSpec.Legend defaults and DesignGraphics; DesignGraphics migrates off its hand-tuned frame and legend origins; clipping policy remains explicit; tests cover panel-only, axes, legend, and design-event plot layout on JVM and JS.
